frequency_question: How often does a scheduled executive branch nomination successfully pass through committee and receive a confirming floor vote within the specified timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes all formal nominations to Senate-confirmed executive agency head posts; excludes judicial nominees and purely advisory boards.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: Sample of high-profile executive confirmations examined for procedural completion.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively list every minor agency sub-cabinet post, focusing on principal officers.
skeleton: Nominations reaching the Senate floor during periods of unified or divided government with standard procedural timelines.
multiplier: 6 hits / 6 selected major health/cabinet confirmations sampled across recent administrations
validity_reason: Senate confirmation rules and procedural baselines remain stable through the current presidential term.
